name: Slatted TV Cabinet
note: Slatted spruce doors on tapered legs, sized to your wall.
description: A low cabinet with hand-slatted doors, built to sit under a television and hide everything that plugs into it. The slats are ripped from one plank so the grain runs continuously across both doors, and the legs are tapered by hand so the whole thing reads lighter than it is. Cable ports are cut wherever your sockets happen to be.
materials: Solid spruce, occasionally oak on request

name: Pendant Beam
note: 1,8 m solid pine light over your table

name: Pool Table Dining Top
note: Two-part top, lifts off in a minute
description: A two-part top that turns a pool table into a dining table and back again in about a minute. Each half is light enough to lift alone, felt-lined underneath so nothing touches the cloth, and edged so the two halves close into one flat surface with no visible seam. Stores upright against a wall.

images.alt: Two-part wooden dining top over a pool table

name: Floating Wall Shelves
description: Full-wall pine shelving on hidden steel fixings — no brackets, no visible screws. Cut to the exact length of your alcove or wall so the shelf meets both sides cleanly, which is the whole reason these exist. Priced per shelf; most rooms take three or four.
materials: Solid pine, 30 mm, softened front edge
